Package neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline

Class SteadyStateConvergenceReport

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.pipeline.SteadyStateConvergenceReport
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class SteadyStateConvergenceReport extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable diagnostics from a TwoFluidPipe steady-state initialization.

Every residual is dimensionless. The mass-flux residual is compared with getMassFluxTolerance(), and the other residuals with getTolerance(). Holdup and liquid-split residuals are absolute volume-fraction changes. Pressure-update, thermodynamic-property, pressure-drop, and pressure-momentum residuals are relative changes. A report is converged only when every applicable residual is below the tolerance and the mandatory final thermodynamic/holdup consistency pass has also settled.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim

  • Constructor Details

    • SteadyStateConvergenceReport

      public SteadyStateConvergenceReport(SteadyStateConvergenceReport.TerminationReason terminationReason, int iterations, double tolerance, double pressureMomentumResidual, double pressureUpdateResidual, double liquidHoldupResidual, double liquidSplitResidual, double thermodynamicResidual, double pressureDropResidual)
      Create a legacy steady-state convergence report without a mass-flux measurement. The mass-flux getters return NaN; the supplied termination reason retains its original meaning.
      Parameters:
      terminationReason - reason the solver stopped
      iterations - number of refinement sweeps performed
      tolerance - dimensionless convergence tolerance
      pressureMomentumResidual - accumulated pressure-march residual normalized by pressure drop
      pressureUpdateResidual - maximum relative pressure correction
      liquidHoldupResidual - maximum absolute total-liquid-holdup correction
      liquidSplitResidual - maximum absolute water-holdup correction
      thermodynamicResidual - maximum relative thermodynamic-property correction
      pressureDropResidual - relative total-pressure-drop correction between sweeps

    • SteadyStateConvergenceReport

      public SteadyStateConvergenceReport(SteadyStateConvergenceReport.TerminationReason terminationReason, int iterations, double tolerance, double pressureMomentumResidual, double pressureUpdateResidual, double liquidHoldupResidual, double liquidSplitResidual, double thermodynamicResidual, double pressureDropResidual, double massFluxResidual, double massFluxTolerance)
      Create a steady-state convergence report including source-free total mass transport.
      Parameters:
      terminationReason - reason the solver stopped
      iterations - number of refinement sweeps performed
      tolerance - dimensionless tolerance for the hydraulic and thermodynamic residuals
      pressureMomentumResidual - accumulated pressure-march residual normalized by pressure drop
      pressureUpdateResidual - maximum relative pressure correction
      liquidHoldupResidual - maximum absolute total-liquid-holdup correction
      liquidSplitResidual - maximum absolute water-holdup correction
      thermodynamicResidual - maximum relative thermodynamic-property correction
      pressureDropResidual - relative total-pressure-drop correction between sweeps
      massFluxResidual - maximum section total mass-flux error normalized by absolute inlet mass flow
      massFluxTolerance - dimensionless tolerance for the total mass-flux residual
